_doc: Spotless Browse tile colours, the one list both apps use. Mac: ui/src/lib/discover/data.ts imports this file. iPhone: SearchView.swift mirrors the same hexes. Our own set, not Spotify's: saturated, distinct, white text at least 4.5:1 on every one (crates/core/src/browse_tiles.rs tests it). `fixed` are the five fixed tiles; `palette` colours the genre and mood tiles in order, cycling.
